_comment: Ground-truth test cases for the Permission Gate. Test runner uses test-specific policy files (see tests/policies/) where: deny-list includes standard patterns, 'bash' is ungated, 'metasploit' is gated_until phase-01, egress_hosts = ['localhost', '127.0.0.1'], and phase-01 is active.

cases.description: Deny-list hit: rm -rf / is blocked regardless of tool or phase
Deny-list miss + ungated tool: ls /tmp passes all gates
Phase-gate denial: metasploit gated_until phase-01 which is active but not passing
Egress denial: curl to host not in egress_hosts allowlist
Fully allowed: echo hello on ungated bash tool with no network or deny-list match
Egress allowed: curl to localhost (in egress_hosts)
